title: The task-why-cited guard reads the stored item when a page edit changes only part of a cite
why: Gap found by lane task-names-check-line-not-truth: on a waiting-page task, a str_replace that swaps only part of a cite token (the route id alone, the date alone) or removes the whole cite passes the task-why-cited guard, because the hook sees only old_str and new_str.
note: Coordinator ruling, 15:19 CST: the guard reads the stored item once per page str_replace on a cite field, and only then. The cost goes in the record, with a test. A failed stored read reads unknown and asks; it never passes silently. Stacked PR on the lane's own PR, after the hand-off. Home: decision task-names-its-check, Known limit. Not done (coordinator's Explore agent (Sonnet) read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 05:01 CST Nov 10): open PR #1640 carries it; its lane session has ended.
